description: Irrigated land 2002 and 2017 is a dataset listed in Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Reporting - Public. This dataset shows the total irrigated agricultural land area across New Zealand for 2002 and 2017. Agricultural land irrigated in 2017 is broken down by types of irrigation systems and farm type. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Reporting - Public. Its tags are Environment Aotearoa 2019, EA2019. It offers 1 resource(s) in table. The portal shows 2019-04-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-mfe-portal.
